speaker: The Archivist
message: Watch. Here is the scroll cut at forty words: "...the Archivist recorded a dose of forty" — and it ends. Here is the same scroll cut at two hundred and fifty with thirty words of overlap: "...a dose of forty milligrams, taken at dusk." Same shelf, same Oracle, same question. The only thing that changed is where the scissors fell.

check.question: Why did the first cut produce a confident wrong answer instead of no answer?
options: The retrieval step failed to find the scroll
The chunk was found, but the fact was split across the cut
The Oracle was configured with the wrong temperature
check.why: Retrieval worked — it returned the right scroll. The fact just did not survive the cut, and a model handed half a fact tends to finish it rather than stop.
